slices.name: Brain authoring and construction
slices.focus: Declared architecture, optimizer, loss, replay/Q-learning and training overrides: every accepted field must change behavior or refuse; required/extra fields; invalid combinations; actual optimizer/loss/schedule behavior.

slices.name: Networks and token observation ABI
slices.focus: Flat, dueling, token-set and recurrent networks; compiled token ABI, masks/empty sets, mean/attention aggregation, hidden state shape, static context, permutation/visibility and transfer identity.

slices.name: Learner and lane lifecycle
slices.focus: Real Q updates, vanilla/Double DQN, successor action legality, recurrent targets/burn-in/padding/hidden state, learning clocks, target sync, clipping, eligible lanes, completion exactly once, checkpoint state. PRIORITY: Astra sees action selection masked but Bellman targets unmasked at population lines894-917,999-1000: run disabled-successor-action high-Q witness for feedforward/recurrent and both DQN variants. No claim without runtime proof or fully explicit source-derived proof.

slices.name: Replay and sequence storage
slices.focus: Uniform/PER sampling, alpha/beta/importance weights/priorities, zero/NaN/invalid refusals, terminal vs truncation, recurrent sequences/padding/episode separation, restore validation/atomicity/RNG. Coordinate with B03 on missing next-action legality mask in replay and targets.

slices.name: Exploration and intrinsic reward
slices.focus: Action legality, all-invalid mask and epsilon edges; RND predictor/normalization eligible samples, intrinsic scale, annealing gates/clocks, episode events, determinism/resume; accepted knobs with actual consumers. Inspect algorithm correctness, not claims of convergence.

slices.name: Curriculum and progression
slices.focus: Authored curriculum/thresholds, declared stages, progression/regression/progress windows, per-lane completion events vs batch updates, static vs adversarial behavior, checkpoint coverage, no survival-world special cases.

slices.name: Brain compilation and effective configuration
slices.focus: Content-based brain/training discovery, full level overrides, five effective brain overrides, provenance/location of refusal, compiled vs runtime semantics; current brain and training contracts across all four network families. Restrict compiler review to BaC-facing logic; VFS was already reviewed.

slices.name: Artifacts, checkpoint identity and transfer
slices.focus: Effective brain identity/lineage, artifact and cache round-trip, checkpoint strict validation, same-universe identity vs explicit cross-universe token transfer, token/schema vs flat/layout checks, atomic load/refusal. Source state owners B03/B09 share seam; request their evidence.

slices.name: Training runner and live inference
slices.focus: Authored configuration actually used by production runner, four-family train/inference parity, budgets/caps/resume state/RNG, checkpoint lifecycle, effective brain reconstruction. PRIORITY Astra sees unconditional episode5000 generalization randomization runner543-565 and always-AdaptiveIntrinsicExploration runner423-441: reproduce declared-vs-effective mismatch cheaply without a 5000-episode run.

slices.name: Training outcomes and persisted telemetry
slices.focus: Truthful persisted steps/transitions/survival/reward/completion, per-lane vs vector units, checkpoint step/curve linkage, recorder transitions after death, no duplicated completion/curriculum updates, consumers distinguish completed/interrupted/failed.

slices.name: Environment-to-learner boundary
slices.focus: Only BaC boundary, not a new VFS audit: reset/step observation alignment, eligibility on entry and terminal successor, action legality, termination vs truncation, agent/world independence and reset/resume ownership. Minimal authored lifecycle witness [2,5] ->7 transitions; send mismatches to B03/B04/B09.

slices.name: Launchers, baseline evaluation and configuration loaders
slices.focus: CLI-to-runner semantics, train/eval toggles and declared choices, baseline comparability, direct YAML readers vs declaration content discovery, flags/knobs ignored or late crashes, runnable authored workflow. Historical baseline script is not automatically current authority.
